note: THE MACHINE. Both commanders are free (command zone), and between them they tax every card that moves: Brallin turns each DISCARD into 1 damage to EACH opponent and a +1/+1 counter; Shabraz turns each DRAW into a +1/+1 counter and 1 life. A wheel is therefore two payments, and the deck is the pile of cards that gets paid twice. Arithmetic, from the oracle text: one Wheel of Fortune with Brallin out is 7 to each opponent on the discard half; add Glint-Horn Buccaneer and it is 14; add Psychosis Crawler on the redraw and it is 21. Two wheels close a 40-life table. That is the declared win line and it is the reason `model_discard` is on.
_shuffle_note: THE HALF THE DECK GIVES AWAY, measured 2026-09-13. Of the 14 hand-refill effects this model reads, only SIX discard. Six SHUFFLE the hand into the library (Echo of Eons, Time Reversal, Commit // Memory, Winds of Change, Molten Psyche, Whirlpool Warrior) and two put it on the BOTTOM (Arjun, Teferi's Puzzle Box). None of those eight is a discard, so none of them triggers Brallin, Glint-Horn Buccaneer, Drake Haven, Containment Construct, Currency Converter or Rielle — the entire discard half of the deck. Priced at 4,000 games, seed 3: rewriting only those six to discard instead of shuffle leaves card draw IDENTICAL at 14.78 extra cards by turn ten and moves cards discarded 7.58 -> 12.22 and cumulative per-opponent ping damage 9.61 -> 14.53. They refill exactly as well and pay half as much. This is a RANKING INPUT, not a cut list: shuffling the graveyard back is a real benefit these cards are bought for.
_flags_note: model_treasures is deliberately OFF. Five cards in the 99 make Treasure but only Generous Plunderer has a trigger this model reads (upkeep); the other four are `unmodelled` triggers, so the flag would restate every figure in the deck to model one card. `model-coverage` names it as DARK, which is the honest place for it. model_sacrifice is off for the same reason: two DARK cards, neither a sacrifice engine.
_required_note: `required` marks what this deck cannot function without, and exactly ONE group carries it: a wheel. Every payoff here is a tax collector with nothing to tax until a hand empties and refills. `route` marks the two ways this deck closes, counted as a UNION rather than multiplied.

targets.label: A WHEEL drawn — the ignition; nothing else in the deck starts itself
A DISCARD wheel drawn — the half that pays Brallin (the other eight shuffle or bottom)
A second per-discard DAMAGE source drawn (doubles Brallin's half of every wheel)
A per-draw DAMAGE source drawn (taxes the refill half)
A discard converted to board or cards (the non-damage half of the tax)
A per-draw BOARD source drawn (the air force the commanders fly with)
THE WHEEL KILL — a DISCARD wheel plus a stacked per-card damage source
THE AIR KILL — a wheel plus a flying body that grows on every card
Ramp drawn — an accelerant of any kind
Commander protection drawn — the whole engine is one 4-drop that dies to everything
A real answer drawn — a counter, a sweeper or a tax
Hand-size relief drawn — the deck routinely holds more than seven
